facts.business: Sparc Electrex Limited (formerly Sparc Systems Limited) is an Indian listed company; the excerpts do not describe its business activities.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (1) inventory write-off of Rs 231.47 lakh and obsolescence provision of Rs 75 lakh without valuation reports or supporting documents; (2) trade receivables write-back of Rs 48.16 lakh without adequate reasons, documentation, or balance confirmations; (3) trade payables write-off of Rs 99.09 lakh without adequate reasons, documentation, or balance confirmations; (4) incomplete forfeiture of 95,32,775 partly paid-up rights issue shares as of 31 March 2026.

key_risks: Inventory valuation and write-offs lack supporting documentation
Trade receivables write-backs without adequate evidence or confirmations
Trade payables write-offs without adequate evidence or confirmations
